result.title: Align or Fail: The Hidden Gap in Cross-Domain Panoptic Segmentation
result.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, Accepted at ACCV 2026 Workshop MLCSA
result.summary: Vision foundation backbones are often treated as drop-in upgrades for improving region proposals in open-vocabulary panoptic segmentation (OVPS). Yet, improvements in backbones often fail to translate well into downstream cross-domain performance. Using ODISE, a diffusion-based OVPS model with a CLIP-based recognition branch, as a testbed, we replace its diffusion visual extractor with DINOv2, ConvNeXt, or DINOv3, and find that backbone upgrades can introduce a grouping-recognition mismatch: an alignment gap between dense-region features and CLIP text embeddings. Across source and near-domain, the newer DINOv3 variant improves source-domain performance but collapses on several cross-domain targets, whereas other baselines, interestingly, show the opposite. Stage-wise diagnostics, linear probes, and region-text alignment analyses indicate that DINOv3 embeddings retain semantic information but are geometrically incompatible with CLIP. We test adaptations, including text-side adapters, conformal mask retention (CMR), and a lean 2.7M-parameter visual-side LoRA, and find that text-side adaptation is more sensitive to vocabulary overlap. CMR provides only limited and target-specific gains, indicating that retention alone cannot resolve the full cross-domain failure. To understand why ADE20K resists improvement across all interventions, we evaluate OVSeg, CAT-Seg, and MaskCLIP. This separates two failure axes: a recoverable visual-to-CLIP interface gap that visual-side LoRA largely repairs, and a vocabulary-boundary limitation shared by the evaluated CLIP-based recognition systems that requires different remedies.

AI.brief_summary: 论文以扩散式 OVPS 模型 ODISE 为测试床，将其视觉提取器替换为 DINOv2、ConvNeXt 或 DINOv3，诊断跨域全景分割中密集区域特征与 CLIP 文本嵌入之间的「分组—识别错配」，并对比文本侧适配、conformal mask retention 与 2.7M 参数视觉侧 LoRA 等修复手段，区分出可修复的视觉—CLIP 接口缺口与词表边界限制两类失败。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「语义信息仍在但与文本嵌入空间几何不兼容」的诊断及视觉侧 LoRA 修复，可能为 LVR 中 latent 视觉状态能否被语言侧读出、跨域时视觉证据是否真的保留提供可供核查的线索，但任务本身是分割而非多模态推理。
